Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) used to empty cryptocurrency wallets
Injected into custom Electron applications mimicking cryptocurrency trade management tools and poker app
Keylogging, taking screenshots, uploading and downloading files, executing commands on victim's console
Cross-platform targeting Windows, Linux, and macOS
Promoted via social media (Twitter, Telegram) and online forums (bitcointalk, SteemCoinPan)
Attack Vector: Trojanized Electron applications (Jamm, eTrade, DaoPoker) downloaded and launched by victims
Command-and-control (C2) servers accessed via pastebin pages
Indicators of Compromise: Pastebin pages used for C2 server addresses accessed ~6,500 times in 2020
Low or no detection on VirusTotal at time of writing
YARA rule provided by Intezer for detection of ElectroRAT in-memory artifacts
